subject: general
question: Devesh starts from Point Y and drives 21 km towards the east. He then takes a left turn, drives 25 km, turns left and drives 67 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 29 km. He takes a right turn, drives 46 km, turns left, drives 41 km to stop at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution: Given: Devesh starts from Point Y and drives 21 km towards the east. He then takes a left turn, drives 25 km, turns left and drives 67 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 29 km. He takes a right turn, drives 46 km, turns left, drives 41 km to stop at Point Z.
